subject: axolotl
pitch:
Category: Animal.
Subject: axolotl with frilly pink gills.
Style: chibi.

requests.what: Add delicate branching filaments to every frilly pink axolotl gill: three to five thin rounded tendrils per fan, alternating rose pink and coral pink, with tiny rounded tips. Keep the silhouette soft and cute.
Add two large glossy cream-white eye highlights and tiny pale pink cheek freckles, placed symmetrically on the face. Use only PALE, CREAM, and GILL_LIGHT.
Add a simple dark plum smiling mouth line with two tiny rounded mouth corners and a subtle pale lower-lip highlight. Keep it broad, friendly, and readable from the front.
Add a small cluster of three to five soft lavender-pink circular spots across the cream belly, arranged like cute freckles rather than a regular pattern.
Add three tiny rounded toes on each of the four feet. Toes should be short, separated, and pale cream with lavender-pink toe pads, following the relaxed neutral pose.
Add a simple translucent-looking pale pink tail fin as a broad low-poly membrane along the last third of the tail, with a rounded triangular silhouette and a slightly darker pink rim.
Add small darker rose-pink collar rings where each external gill joins the head, plus one tiny pale bead on each collar. The collars should look integrated, not like floating jewelry.
Add a tiny stylized aqua water-drop emblem centered high on the forehead, outlined in DARK_PLUM and filled with AQUA, sized like a cute sticker seated on the head.
Paint a very subtle flat-colour mottled pattern over the body using BODY_BLUE, BODY_LIGHT, and AQUA: broad irregular low-contrast patches, never noisy or realistic.
Paint soft warm pink blush patches on both cheeks using GILL_LIGHT and GILL_PINK, while keeping the forehead and muzzle clear for the face and water-drop emblem.
Paint the belly with a gentle two-tone cream-to-lavender transition using CREAM and BELLY_LAVENDER, leaving a clean readable edge against the blue body.
